records.translation: 规划和加载是分开的。:func:`plan_crops` 向数据库或文件夹询问*哪些对象匹配*，完全不读取像素：只是一次 ``COUNT`` 和一次标识符的 ``SELECT``，或者一次 ``scandir``。在包含六万张裁剪图的板上只需几毫秒，因此屏幕可以在一次点击时运行它，并在决定读取之前告诉用户他们请求了什么。随后 :func:`load_crops` 按页读取像素，每读完一页报告一次。在工作线程上运行第二部分的调用方，每页都能得到一个进度数字，并且停止操作会在一页之内生效，而不是等到最后。

records.source: The predicate is SQL and the database is opened read-only. ``where`` is an SQL fragment against the user's own file. records.context: Three counts are kept because rows are removed at two stages, for different reasons. ``matched`` is what the query found, ``selected`` is what the limit left of it, and ``count`` is what survived the merged route's join -- which drops every row with no single object label (``'omulti'`` / ``'onone'``) or no merged array recorded. records.label: spacr.crop_loader.CropPlan#7
records.source: Three counts are kept because rows are removed at two stages, for different reasons. ``matched`` is what the query found, ``selected`` is what the limit left of it, and ``count`` is what survived the merged route's join -- which drops every row with no single object label (``'omulti'`` / ``'onone'``) or no merged array recorded. records.translation: 保留三个计数，是因为行会在两个阶段、出于不同原因被移除。``matched`` 是查询找到的数量，``selected`` 是限制之后剩下的数量，``count`` 是经过合并路线连接后保留下来的数量——该连接会丢弃每一个没有单一对象标签（``'omulti'`` / ``'onone'``）或没有记录合并数组的行。只有第一个差值是上限，也只有上限可以通过提高 'At most'（最多）来修复；提高一个并未达到的限制只会返回相同的行。

records.context: Against :attr:`selected`, never against :attr:`count`: a merged-route load that lost rows to the join has ``matched > count`` without reaching the limit, and that is not a cap.
records.label: spacr.crop_loader.CropPlan.capped#1

records.context: The extracted image region is padded, not resized: a stack has to be rectangular before a backbone sees it, and rescaling an extracted image region changes the apparent size of the object in it, which is a phenotype. Zero-padding changes the background, which is not. It is also what :func:`spacr.crop_source.crop_at` already does to a box that runs off the edge of a microscope field of view, so two extracted image regions of the same object arrive the same way whichever route cut them.
records.label: spacr.crop_loader.conform_crop#1
records.source: The crop is padded, not resized: a stack has to be rectangular before a backbone sees it, and rescaling a crop changes the apparent size of the object in it, which is a phenotype. Zero-padding changes the background, which is not. It is also what :func:`spacr.crop_source.crop_at` already does to a box that runs off the edge of a field, so two crops of the same object arrive the same way whichever route cut them.
records.translation: 裁剪图是填充而不是缩放：堆栈在交给骨干网络之前必须是矩形的，而缩放裁剪图会改变其中对象的表观大小，这属于表型。零填充改变的是背景，而背景不属于表型。这也正是 :func:`spacr.crop_source.crop_at` 对超出视野边缘的框所做的处理，因此无论由哪条路线裁切，同一对象的两张裁剪图到达时都是一样的。

records.context: **Duplicates.** A figure is identified by its paper (the DOI when there is one) and its image hash. The same image seen again -- the same bytes, or the same pixels in another file format, under another name or another paper, such as a preprint and its published version -- is measured once and recorded in the ``duplicates`` table against the copy that was measured. A paper already measured from one source (Europe PMC) is not measured again from another (its PDF). An image that only looks the same (a near-identical perceptual hash, as a re-encoded or resized copy would have) is recorded as a possible duplicate and still measured, because a similar hash does not prove that two figures are the same image.
records.label: spacr.plaque_papers#7
records.source: **Duplicates.** A figure is identified by its paper (the DOI when there is one) and its image hash. The same image seen again -- the same bytes, or the same pixels in another file format, under another name or another paper, such as a preprint and its published version -- is measured once and recorded in the ``duplicates`` table against the copy that was measured. A paper already measured from one source (Europe PMC) is not measured again from another (its PDF). An image that only looks the same (a near-identical perceptual hash, as a re-encoded or resized copy would have) is recorded as a possible duplicate and still measured, because a similar hash does not prove that two figures are the same image.
records.translation: **重复。** 一张图形由其论文（有 DOI 时为 DOI）和图像哈希标识。再次见到的同一图像——相同的字节，或另一种文件格式中的相同像素，以其他名称或在另一篇论文中出现，例如预印本及其正式发表版本——只测量一次，并在 ``duplicates`` 表中记录为对应于已测量的那份副本。已从一个来源（Europe PMC）测量过的论文，不会再从另一个来源（其 PDF）重新测量。只是看起来相同的图像（感知哈希几乎相同，就像重新编码或缩放后的副本那样）会被记录为可能的重复，但仍会被测量，因为相似的哈希并不能证明两张图形是同一图像。

records.context: Cellpose predicts, per pixel, a flow toward the centre of the object the pixel belongs to. Timeflows adds the same idea through time: per pixel of frame ``t``, where the centre of that object is in frame ``t+1``, and whether it has a successor at all (cells die, divide, leave the microscope field of view). Linking objects between frames then reads the model instead of guessing from overlap, which is where the plain IoU stitcher fails: fast cells that move more than their own size between frames (the MuSC movies move 3-4 diameters per frame at p95).
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model#1
records.source: Cellpose predicts, per pixel, a flow toward the centre of the object the pixel belongs to. Timeflows adds the same idea through time: per pixel of frame ``t``, where the centre of that object is in frame ``t+1``, and whether it has a successor at all (cells die, divide, leave the field). Linking objects between frames then reads the model instead of guessing from overlap, which is where the plain IoU stitcher fails: fast cells that move more than their own size between frames (the MuSC movies move 3-4 diameters per frame at p95).
records.translation: Cellpose 为每个像素预测一个指向该像素所属对象中心的流。Timeflows 把同样的思路延伸到时间上：对于帧 ``t`` 的每个像素，预测该对象的中心在帧 ``t+1`` 中的位置，以及它究竟是否有后继（细胞会死亡、分裂、离开视野）。于是，在帧之间连接对象时读取的是模型的预测，而不是根据重叠去猜测，而后者正是普通 IoU 拼接器失败的地方：快速移动的细胞在帧间移动的距离超过其自身大小（MuSC 影像在 p95 处每帧移动 3-4 个直径）。

records.context: Contents, all runnable on a CPU:
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model#2

records.translation: 内容如下，全部可在 CPU 上运行：

records.context: :func:`augment_pair` -- one flip/rotation applied identically to both frames and both label images; the targets are computed after it from the labels, so a flip can never teach a displacement that did not happen.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model#5
records.source: :func:`augment_pair` -- one flip/rotation applied identically to both frames and both label images; the targets are computed after it from the labels, so a flip can never teach a displacement that did not happen.
records.translation: :func:`augment_pair`——对两帧及两幅标签图像同等地应用一次翻转/旋转；目标在此之后根据标签计算，因此翻转永远不会教给模型一个并未发生的位移。

records.context: A flip applied to frame ``t`` and not ``t+1`` teaches a displacement that never happened, producing a model that trains well but does not track. Targets are computed from the augmented labels afterwards, so the vectors follow automatically.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.augment_pair#1
records.source: A flip applied to frame ``t`` and not ``t+1`` teaches a displacement that never happened, producing a model that trains well but does not track. Targets are computed from the augmented labels afterwards, so the vectors follow automatically.
records.translation: 只应用于帧 ``t`` 而未应用于 ``t+1`` 的翻转，会教给模型一个从未发生的位移，产生一个训练效果很好却无法跟踪的模型。目标随后根据增强后的标签计算，因此向量会自动随之变化。

records.context: Centred on a random object of the first label image, jittered by up to a quarter window, so windows hold cells rather than empty background. A window shared by both frames leaves every displacement unchanged.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.random_window#1
records.source: Centred on a random object of the first label image, jittered by up to a quarter window, so windows hold cells rather than empty background. A window shared by both frames leaves every displacement unchanged.
records.translation: 以第一幅标签图像中的一个随机对象为中心，随机偏移最多四分之一窗口，使窗口中包含细胞而不是空背景。两帧共享同一窗口，因此每个位移都保持不变。

records.context: The vector is supervised only where there is a successor (``vector_weight``); the successor flag everywhere inside an object (``object_weight``). Background is supervised by neither.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.time_targets#4
records.source: The vector is supervised only where there is a successor (``vector_weight``); the successor flag everywhere inside an object (``object_weight``). Background is supervised by neither.
records.translation: 向量只在存在后继的地方受到监督（``vector_weight``）；后继标志则在对象内部的所有位置受到监督（``object_weight``）。背景两者都不监督。

records.context: The Cell Tracking Challenge publishes tracking ground truth as markers -- a small blob inside each cell, labelled with its track id in every frame -- and full outlines separately (the silver ``ST/SEG`` masks, labelled per frame). Only one-to-one assignments are retained: the object contains exactly one marker ID and that ID overlaps no other segmented object. Unmarked, merged and split assignments are excluded rather than guessed.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.track_masks_from_ctc#1
records.source: The Cell Tracking Challenge publishes tracking ground truth as markers -- a small blob inside each cell, labelled with its track id in every frame -- and full outlines separately (the silver ``ST/SEG`` masks, labelled per frame). Only one-to-one assignments are retained: the object contains exactly one marker ID and that ID overlaps no other segmented object. Unmarked, merged and split assignments are excluded rather than guessed.
records.translation: Cell Tracking Challenge 以标记的形式发布跟踪真值——每个细胞内部的一个小斑点，在每一帧中都以其轨迹 ID 标记——并另外发布完整轮廓（银标准 ``ST/SEG`` 掩膜，按帧标记）。只保留一对一的分配：对象恰好包含一个标记 ID，且该 ID 不与任何其他已分割对象重叠。未标记、合并和分裂的分配会被排除，而不是被猜测。

records.context: A two-stage curriculum: the backbone's segmentation is already trained, so it is frozen while the new head learns, then everything is trained at a low learning rate. Every pair is augmented identically on both frames before its targets are computed.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.train_timeflows#1
records.source: A two-stage curriculum: the backbone's segmentation is already trained, so it is frozen while the new head learns, then everything is trained at a low learning rate. Every pair is augmented identically on both frames before its targets are computed.
records.translation: 两阶段课程：骨干网络的分割已经训练好，因此在新输出头学习期间将其冻结，然后以较低的学习率训练全部参数。每一对图像在计算其目标之前，都会在两帧上进行完全相同的增强。

records.context: It checks the annotation, not a tracker. Scoring a predicted tracking against a ground truth is :mod:`spacr.timeflows_baseline`, which is step 2 of the same plan. It holds no graphical code and opens no dialogs.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_qc#11
records.source: It checks the annotation, not a tracker. Scoring a predicted tracking against a ground truth is :mod:`spacr.timeflows_baseline`, which is step 2 of the same plan. It holds no graphical code and opens no dialogs.
records.translation: 它检查的是标注，而不是跟踪器。根据真值为预测的跟踪结果评分属于 :mod:`spacr.timeflows_baseline`，即同一方案的第 2 步。它不包含任何图形代码，也不打开任何对话框。

records.context: The timeflows plan rests on one claim about the training data: an object keeps the same label in every frame it appears in. A time-flow head is trained to point from a pixel of an object in frame ``t`` at that object's centre in frame ``t+1``, and the only thing that says which object in ``t+1`` is the same object is the label. If the annotation recycles a label after its object dies or leaves, the model is trained to point at an unrelated cell, and no later score catches it -- the held-out check scrambles the same wrong labels and agrees with itself.

A time-flow head is trained to point from a pixel of an object in frame ``t`` at that object's centre in frame ``t+1``, and the only thing that says which object in ``t+1`` is the same object is the label. If the annotation recycles a label after its object dies or leaves, the model is trained to point at an unrelated cell, and no later score catches it -- the held-out check scrambles the same wrong labels and agrees with itself.
records.translation: timeflows 方案建立在关于训练数据的一个论断之上：对象在其出现的每一帧中都保持相同的标签。时间流输出头被训练为从帧 ``t`` 中某对象的一个像素指向该对象在帧 ``t+1`` 中的中心，而唯一能说明 ``t+1`` 中哪个对象是同一个对象的就是标签。如果标注在对象死亡或离开之后重复使用了某个标签，模型就会被训练为指向一个无关的细胞，而之后的任何评分都无法发现——留出检查打乱的是同样错误的标签，因而与自身一致。
